# CUEPA for You

> One-on-one AI help for individuals. A one-hour session with Marcos and the
> CUEPA team, working on your real tasks with AI, in plain language.
> CUEPA for You is part of ELIPAN GROUP.

## What we do
- One-hour, one-on-one AI sessions for individuals, held over video call
- We work on your real stuff: your week, your inbox, your money, or an idea you keep putting off
- No tech background needed; we start wherever you are
- After the session: a one-page recap with what we covered and the prompts we built

## Where
Virtual, over video call. Available anywhere.

## Who you work with
Marcos Cuellar and the CUEPA team. Marcos has been learning and studying AI
since it came out.

## Who it's for
Individuals, not businesses. Parents, professionals, freelancers, creators,
learners, and anyone who feels behind on AI.
For business and team work, see CUEPA for Work: https://www.makingcuepa.com/

## How booking works
1. Book a session on the website (name, email, what's on your mind)
2. Marcos or someone on the team reaches out with details and times
3. Pay for the session through a secure link to hold your time
4. Meet for one hour, then receive your recap

## Pricing
Shared by email after you book. Booking is free.

## Contact
Email: marcoscuellar@elipangroup.com
Website: https://you.makingcuepa.com/
